claims.assertion: Swaruu X (Athena) describes Hanáre/Scimitar A as an interceptor and B as an assault and evacuation craft carrying troops and vehicles.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: The A is faster; the B is heavier.

claims.assertion: Athena says toroidal high-energy stealth hides Scimitars from human visual, infrared, and microwave detection.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She says gravitic-shift detectors could still detect them.

claims.assertion: Athena describes older Scimitars as reliable and durable, though their engine components are difficult to access and maintain.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: Despite age and maintenance demands, she says they remain in service.
